(4) HYPOTHESIS: if the tiny DC step is genuinely (even marginally) helpful, a0.0 @ seed43 < iter-14s 0.8699; if within +-0.002, the DC step is DISPENSABLE and the simplest architecture (pure denoiser, a0.0) is as good -> report a0.0 as the canonical config.
